summary: This note is a brief biographical entry on Aaron Spelling (April 22, 1923 – June 23, 2006), described as an American film and television producer. It lists several of his best-known television programs with their broadcast years, including Charlie's Angels, The Love Boat, Dynasty, Beverly Hills, 90210, 7th Heaven and Charmed. It also names additional series he produced, such as Mod Squad, The Rookies and Sunset Beach.
one_line: Biographical entry on Aaron Spelling, American film and television producer, and the television series he produced.
key_facts: Aaron Spelling was an American film and television producer.
Aaron Spelling produced the TV program Charlie's Angels, which aired 1976–81.
Aaron Spelling produced the TV program The Love Boat, which aired 1977–86.
Aaron Spelling produced the TV program Hart to Hart, which aired 1979–84.
Aaron Spelling produced the TV program Dynasty, which aired 1981–89.
Aaron Spelling produced the TV program Beverly Hills, 90210, which aired 1990–2000.
Aaron Spelling produced the TV program 7th Heaven, which aired 1996–2007.
Aaron Spelling produced the TV program Charmed, which aired 1998–2006.
Aaron Spelling served as producer of Mod Squad, which aired 1968-1973.
Aaron Spelling served as producer of The Rookies, which aired 1972-1976.
Aaron Spelling served as producer of Sunset Beach, which aired 1997-1999.
